slug.description: Active game slug. The workbench UI fills this automatically for manual use; an AI/agent caller MUST pass the active game's slug (e.g. 'mini-gta'). Required.

assetName.description: Desired base file name (without extension). Sanitized + de-duplicated by the store.

previewTaskId.description: Meshy preview task id (the sourceJobId of a prior gen3d:text-to-3d call with provider=meshy). Meshy-only second stage that adds texture to a white-mesh preview.

texturePrompt.description: Optional text guidance for texture generation (<=600 chars).
